title: Desk: near-signal producer for the scan packet's system_book (legs within one bar of a signal), so near_signals_read_state can read
note: Filed 2026-10-26 by lane session_01WjV8syWhW3awUxZ7FTavhZ (DESK-16). MEASURED: no producer of near-signals exists in src/ or scripts/ (grep near_signal / bars_to_signal / signal_proximity returns only the desk guard). Until built, every scan packet carries system_book.near_signals_read_state = could_not_look (named), so a proposal that duplicates a near-signal cannot be detected and novelty degrades to 'unverifiable' when no open package matches. Scope: per rostered leg, evaluate its signal function on the last closed bar +/- one bar (read-only, no order path), emit {leg, symbol, side, timeframe, bars_to_signal}; inject via desk_scan_packet.build_scan_packet(near_signals=...). Also unbuilt (named in every packet's missing_inputs, lower priority): regime_cell per symbol, spread/funding reads, light-tier venue listing (Bybit public API is geo-blocked from sessions).  | 2026-10-26 BUILT by session_017GFXhSVea4htC1vmaymZBc: scripts/ops/desk_near_signals.py (unit-probe, not a re-implementation) wired into desk_scan_packet.py main(); near_signals_read_state read only when every leg x symbol looked, else could_not_look + N-of-M named. MEASURED live (public candle route, 2026-10-26, python3 scripts/ops/desk_near_signals.py): 26 of 26 rostered leg x symbol looked, 4 near-signals (read). First run the same hour read 23 of 26 (MES/MGC/MHG 1d: the route returns no_data at limit 1000; MGC/MHG served at limit 200) so the denominator moves with the route. landed_unproven: closes when a desk session (DESK-6) reads a scan packet's near-signals and a later package confirms or refutes a bars_to_signal=1 item. Open: account-level side_filter, regime router and market-hours gates are not reproduced; MES daily returned no_data in one of two runs.
